title_en: First deposit: where does the money come from, and where does it go?
title_zh: 第一次入金：钱从哪里来，进到哪里去？
goal_en: Tell apart a fiat deposit, buying crypto, an on-chain deposit and an internal transfer.
goal_zh: 能区分法币入金、买币、链上充值与账户内部划转。

shots.visual_en: One screen shows Deposit, Buy crypto and Transfer; Sam's finger hovers between the three buttons.
shots.visual_zh: 同一屏幕出现充值、买币、划转，小白的手指在三个按钮间犹豫。

lines.en: These all look like putting money in. Which one do I press?
lines.zh: 这些都像把钱转进去，我到底该按哪个？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S1 · E06' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第1季 · 第06集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: First deposit: where does the money come from, and where does it go?
onscreen_text_zh: 第一次入金：钱从哪里来，进到哪里去？

shots.visual_en: Three animated channels, each with a start and end: Bank → Platform; Existing coins → Platform; Account → Account on the same platform.
shots.visual_zh: 三个带起终点的动画通道：银行→平台；已有币→平台；同平台账户→账户。

lines.en: Start with what you're holding. Money in your bank, coins you already have somewhere else, or a balance in another account on the same platform. Each one takes a different route.
lines.zh: 先看你手里是什么。银行里的法币、其他地方已有的币、平台里另一个账户的余额，需要走的路不一样。

shots.visual_en: Fiat path shows: amount paid, estimated arrival, fee, supported regions. Never shows any channel as 'available worldwide'.
shots.visual_zh: 法币路径显示支付金额、预计到账、手续费、支持地区；不写某通道全球可用。

lines.en: A fiat deposit usually adds a cash balance to your account. Buying crypto directly means you pay and receive a crypto asset. Some platforms support bank or card channels, some don't, and fees and limits differ.
lines.zh: 法币充值通常是给账户增加法币余额；直接买币则是付款后获得加密资产。有的平台支持银行或银行卡渠道，有的不支持，费用和限制也不同。

shots.visual_en: Existing-coins path shows coin and network; the internal transfer only moves an account label, no on-chain hash shown.
shots.visual_zh: 已有币路径显示币种与网络；内部划转只移动账户标签，不展示链上哈希。

lines.en: If you already hold crypto, you can deposit it using a supported coin and network. An internal transfer just moves balance between your accounts. It's usually not an on-chain transfer. Check where the balance will land first.
lines.zh: 已有加密资产，可以按支持的币种和网络充值。平台内部划转是账户间调配余额，通常不是链上转账。先确认余额会到哪里。

shots.visual_en: A P2P (user-to-user) branch appears with an eligibility check and a separate safety note. Antenna amber.
shots.visual_zh: 出现P2P用户间交易分支，旁边提示资格核验与独立安全说明。

lines.en: Some platforms also offer trading between users. That's not another name for a bank transfer. Never pay off-platform in private, never use funds of unknown origin or third-party payments. If it's unclear, don't do it yet.
lines.zh: 有的平台还提供用户间交易，但不是银行转账的同义词。不要私下脱离平台付款，不使用来路不明或第三方代付资金；没看懂就先不操作。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Can a bank balance be sent straight to a USDT on-chain address?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：银行余额能直接发送到USDT链上地址吗？

lines.en: Right. Look at the asset first, then the route, and finally check what actually arrived.
lines.zh: 对，先看资产，再看路径，最后核对实际到账。

onscreen_text_zh: 银行余额 → USDT地址？ 不能

shots.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
shots.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

lines.en: BTC/USDT: does that slash mean you buy two coins? Next: your first spot trade.
lines.zh: BTC/USDT中间这道斜杠，是要买两种币吗？下一集：第一笔现货。

onscreen_text_en: BTC/USDT: does that slash mean you buy two coins? Next: your first spot trade.
onscreen_text_zh: BTC/USDT中间这道斜杠，是要买两种币吗？下一集：第一笔现货。

shots.visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。
onscreen_text_en: One verified gateway to the world's exchanges
onscreen_text_zh: 全球交易所，一个官方入口

end_hook.en: BTC/USDT: does that slash mean you buy two coins? Next: your first spot trade.
end_hook.zh: BTC/USDT中间这道斜杠，是要买两种币吗？下一集：第一笔现货。

exercise.task_en: Match three sources of funds to: fiat deposit, on-chain deposit and internal transfer.
exercise.task_zh: 将三种资金来源匹配到法币入金、链上充值和内部划转。
exercise.answer_en: Bank money and on-chain token addresses can't be mixed. Check each channel separately.
exercise.answer_zh: 银行法币与链上代币地址不能混用；每条通道独立核验。

red_lines: Never imply users must use P2P ｜ 不默认用户必须使用P2P
No real payee accounts or payment QR codes in the general animation ｜ 真实收款账号和付款码不得出现在通用动画中
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
